long_biography.plain_text:
Soccer became Joey Saputo's separate arena within a family business world built around dairy, transport and investment holdings. An economics graduate of Concordia University, he joined Saputo and led its United States dairy division before helping form the Montréal Impact in 1993. He later drove the club's return, purpose-built stadium and entry into Major League Soccer.

Saputo eventually left the dairy company to focus on the club and Free2Be, his holding company. In 2014 he joined the acquisition of Bologna FC, soon became its controlling shareholder and guided its return to Serie A. He now chairs both CF Montréal and Bologna, with professional executives handling daily operations, while also overseeing forestry interests and serving on corporate boards.
